info.title: MARE API
info.description: Generated OpenAPI specification for MARE API V1 routes.

tags.name: Observations
tags.description: Access biological observation records and related data. These endpoints support observation retrieval, filtering, aggregation, review workflows, video-based queries, keyframe associations, and observation updates.

Keyframe.description: Frame-specific annotation associated with an observation.

ModelSpecies.description: Join record linking an ML model to a species it was trained to detect or classify, including per-species dataset size, training weight, and evaluation metrics.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this model-species linkage record.

model_id.description: Identifier of the associated ML model.

dataset_size.description: Number of image or annotation samples of this species used for training this model.

balance_weight.description: Relative weight used for balancing this species during training. Higher means more importance.

precision_mean.description: Mean precision achieved by the model for this species during evaluation.

recall_mean.description: Mean recall achieved by the model for this species during evaluation.

f1_mean.description: Mean F1-score for this species within this model, across validation epochs.

notes.description: Freeform notes describing this model-species relationship.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated.

Observation.description: Biological or habitat observation recorded during a MARP session. The fields available in a response may depend on the query and any Sequelize associations included by that endpoint.

observation_id.description: Primary database identifier for the observation.

obsID.description: Observation identifier used within the source workflow.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project associated with the observation.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session associated with the observation.

user_id.description: Identifier of the user associated with the observation.

tc.description: Starting time code for the observation.

frame.description: Stored source-frame value associated with the observation.

taxserial.description: Taxonomic serial identifier associated with the observation.

comname.description: Common name assigned to the observed taxon.

count.description: Number of individuals represented by the observation.

coarsesize.description: Coarse size classification assigned to the observation.

quadrant.description: Quadrant value associated with the observation.

etc.description: Ending time code for the observation.

note.description: Free-text note associated with the observation.

downcamera.description: Stored down-camera value associated with the observation.

video_source.description: Video source associated with the observation.

videoLocation.description: Stored location of the associated video.

mediaPosition.description: Stored position of the observation within the source media.

actualPosition.description: Stored actual-position value associated with the observation.

substrate_bedrock.description: Indicates whether bedrock substrate was recorded.

substrate_megaclast.description: Indicates whether megaclast substrate was recorded.

substrate_boulder.description: Indicates whether boulder substrate was recorded.

substrate_cobble.description: Indicates whether cobble substrate was recorded.

substrate_pebble.description: Indicates whether pebble substrate was recorded.

substrate_granule.description: Indicates whether granule substrate was recorded.

substrate_sand.description: Indicates whether sand substrate was recorded.

substrate_mud.description: Indicates whether mud substrate was recorded.

substrate_coral_reef.description: Indicates whether coral-reef substrate was recorded.

substrate_coral_rubble.description: Indicates whether coral-rubble substrate was recorded.

substrate_shell_hash.description: Indicates whether shell-hash substrate was recorded.

substrate_shell_rubble.description: Indicates whether shell-rubble substrate was recorded.

substrate_algal.description: Indicates whether algal substrate was recorded.

confidence.description: Machine-learning confidence score between zero and one.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the observation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the observation record was last updated.

Species.description: Taxonomic and GUI display entry used to classify observations, datasets, and ML model training labels throughout MARP.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this species record.

taxserial.description: Internal MARP taxonomy serial number used as a unique ID across systems.

gui_home_order.description: Ordering key used by the MARP GUI to position this item on the home screen.

gui_maintab.description: Main tab category where this item appears in the GUI.

gui_subtab.description: Sub-tab within the main tab where this item is displayed.

gui_main_tab_order.description: Order number for the main tab this item belongs to.

gui_sub_tab_order.description: Order number for the sub-tab this item belongs to.

gui_item_order.description: Position of this species within its GUI sub-tab group.

gui_display_name.description: Display name for this item shown in MARP GUI interfaces, may differ from comname.

comname.description: Common name used for this species.

species.description: Scientific or Latin name of the species.

observation_type.description: Category describing what type of organism this is.

report_group.description: Report grouping used for rollups or reports.

depth_min.description: Minimum depth in meters where this species is typically observed.

depth_max.description: Maximum depth in meters where this species is typically observed.

notes.description: Freeform notes about this species, its classification, or GUI behavior.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this species record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this species record was last updated.

Serves the generated JSDoc website containing internal source-code and module documentation. This endpoint returns HTML and related static assets rather than a JSON API response.

Returns observations whose video_source exactly matches the supplied videoName. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order and include associated keyframes. Observations without keyframes are excluded. An empty array may indicate either that no records matched or that the database query failed.

get.summary: Retrieve video summaries for a project
get.description: Returns one summary row for each distinct combination of video_source and videoLocation associated with sessions in the specified project. Each row includes the number of distinct observation common names, the number of distinct sessions, and representative dive, line, and session type values selected using MIN aggregation. Results are ordered by the representative dive and line in ascending order. Videos without a matching session in the project are excluded. An empty array may mean that no matching observations were found or that the database query failed.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Database identifier of the project whose videos should be summarized.

video_source.description: Video source value shared by the grouped observations.

videoLocation.description: Video location value shared by the grouped observations.

distinct_species_count.description: Number of distinct non-null observation comname values.

session_count.description: Number of distinct sessions represented in the group.

dive.description: Minimum dive value among the matching sessions.

line.description: Minimum line value among the matching sessions.

session_type.description: Minimum session type value among the matching sessions.

get.summary: Retrieve video observations filtered by common name
get.description: Returns observations whose video_source exactly matches videoName and whose comname is included in comnameList. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order and include associated keyframes. Observations without at least one keyframe are excluded. The current repository returns an empty array both when no observations match and when the database query fails.

parameters.name: videoName
parameters.description: Exact value to match against the observation video_source field.

parameters.name: comnameList
parameters.description: Common names used to filter observations. Supply the parameter repeatedly, such as comnameList=Bat%20star&comnameList=Leather%20star.

get.summary: Retrieve observations for a video within a project
get.description: Returns observations whose video_source exactly matches videoName and whose associated session belongs to the project identified by projectName. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order. Associated keyframes are included when available, but observations without keyframes are also returned. An empty array may indicate that no observations matched, the project was not found, or the database query failed.

parameters.name: videoName
parameters.description: Exact value to match against the observation video_source field.

parameters.name: projectName
parameters.description: Exact project name used to locate the associated project record.

get.summary: Retrieve observations with keyframes by common name
get.description: Returns observations whose comname matches one of the supplied common names. The comnameList query parameter must contain a comma-separated list of URL-encoded common names. Results are ordered by mediaPosition in ascending order and include associated keyframes. Observations without at least one keyframe are excluded. An empty array may indicate that no observations matched or that the repository query failed.

parameters.name: comnameList
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of common names. Each value is decoded after the string is split on commas.

200.description: Matching observations with keyframes returned successfully.

500.description: The API request failed before a response could be produced.

get.description: Returns every task row currently available in storage.
Returns all observation records available through the V1 API.

get.summary: Fetch latest video info for a session
get.description: Returns the most recent video metadata associated with a session.
Returns every species record used for taxonomy, GUI display configuration, and ML model training labels. An empty array may indicate either that no records exist or that the database query failed.

get.summary: Fetch a species by common name
get.description: Returns the species record whose comname matches the supplied value, case-insensitively. Returns null both when no species matches and when the database query fails.

200.description: Matching species returned, or null if not found.

post.description: Creates a model_species join record linking an ML model to a species, using the request body directly as the record to insert. Note that when the insert fails the response body is an ErrorResponse-shaped object, but the endpoint currently still responds with HTTP 200 rather than an error status.

200.description: Model-species record created successfully, or an ErrorResponse body if the insert failed (see description).

get.description: Returns metadata identifying the current configured database.
